description: Full feature pages: GridPage with search/geo filtering and live Blogger feed, ProductPage with multi-image carousel, variant/package selection, addons, seller details and reactive add-to-cart/wishlist, and LocationPicker with search and GPS integration.
steps: Step 1 — Implement GridPage with SearchBarWidget, LocationPicker entry chip, responsive 2-column grid, and infinite pagination via GridBloc.
Step 2 — Implement ProductPage with Sliver layout, ImageCarousel, StockBadge, VariantSelector, PackageSelector, AddonSection, SellerCard, SpecsSection, and bottom action bar.
Step 3 — Implement CartPage and CartSheet with real-time CartBloc state, CartItemTile quantity adjustments, and CartProvider for cross-route synchronization.
Step 4 — Implement LocationPickerPage and LocationPickerSheet supporting reverse-geocoded GPS detection and postal/city address search.
Step 5 — Connect all routes via KaiselRouterConfig (HomeRoute, PostRoute, CartRoute, LocationPickerRoute) and wire permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for schema extraction, routing models, geo-filtering, and search query building pass with 100% success.
findings: Fully completed, verified with comprehensive unit test suite and clean analysis.
